diagnosis: Every disconnection event scanned every triple junction to find the normally zero to two adjoining junctions. In the J2 attempt-limited state this made the event path quadratic in event and junction counts.
changes: Build a boundary-to-triple-junction index once per topology update.
Reuse event-ledger and full-field positions for all events on one boundary in one PF step.
Write restart NPZ archives with atomic DEFLATE level 1 while preserving the standard NumPy archive format.

pre_optimization_live_part_intervals_sec.definition: One Parquet part is committed every two PF steps; last 30 intervals from each of five live J2 runs under 16-worker production load.

benchmark_conditions: Each optimized trial cloned a different authoritative live J2 checkpoint, resumed exactly for two steps, committed its Parquet ledger and restart archive, and ran alongside the same production workload plus the benchmark worker.
physics_effect: None. Event ordering, random draws, mode selection, state increments, and output rows are unchanged; only topology lookup, repeated serialization work, and lossless archive compression level changed.
